answers.1_current_loader_requires_map_for_regist: YES: opens property_map_path unconditionally before starting transaction/reading JSONL; missing map fails. It uses property_code->supplier_code only for supplier identifiers.
answers.2_intrinsic_product_registry_requirement: NO: canonical product rows need no supplier map; dedicated article identifiers do. Current implementation couples both operations, so no unsupported map-free invocation is offered.
answers.3_safe_product_only_load: Conceptually possible in a separately explicit product-only mode, preserving existing supplier identifiers; not implemented or authorized here. Current loader cannot safely run without the map. CSV matching context is read-only and not a PostgreSQL registry load.
answers.4_regeneration: scripts/generate_stage3a1_supplier_identifiers.py deterministically derives property namespace suffixes from saved definitions; 1546 ARTIKUL_PARTNER is a special confirmed mapping. Other derived entries are REVIEW. Its main also needs PARTNER_ST_MATCHING_SAMPLE.csv and writes multiple reports; do not run it merely to create a map. Old definitions contain63 ARTIKUL properties and no ARTIKUL_LTT/USS or regional aliases. A syntactic suffix is not confirmation of a supplier namespace. No map created.
answers.5_fresh_get_snapshot: Produces registry JSONL/CSV, raw product/property/section/brand metadata, snapshot metadata; does NOT itself produce supplier-article mapping CSV. Prepared select explicitly requests all discovered ARTIKUL property IDs using the existing GET method. Actual current values/permissions/completeness require separately authorized live verification.
answers.6_required_fields: CSV consumed fields: property_code,supplier_code. Audit/confirmation also needs property_id,property_name,active,mapping_status,mapping_evidence. JSONL needs sterbrust_product_id,name,captured_at,snapshot_hash; identity fields brand_raw,model_raw,article_raw,category_path and properties[]. Each supplier property needs property_id,property_code,value (scalar/list/nested valueEnum/value). Catalog bootstrap must then create catalog_products/catalog_product_identifiers, set sterbrust_products.catalog_product_id; sync supplier identifier links separately. No bootstrap/load done.

registry_load_writes: sterbrust_product_supplier_identifiers DELETE per canonical product then INSERT property values
